description: Unit tests for CTR_DRBG (Counter mode Deterministic Random Byte Generator) in BoringSSL, using Google Test framework. Includes tests for initialization, reseeding, generating random bytes, large data handling, and test vectors.

methods.name: Basic
methods.description: Tests basic initialization, reseeding, and byte generation of CTR_DRBG.

methods.name: Allocated
methods.description: Tests dynamic allocation of CTR_DRBG state.

methods.name: Large
methods.description: Tests generating a large amount of data and verifies output via SHA256.

methods.name: TestVectors
methods.description: Runs predefined test vectors from an external file to verify CTR_DRBG correctness.
